description: Cave Node CORE outcomes for actual character 3 and all seven native nodes in the retained regular save. Native ChanceToHarvest and SpelunkingOreValue bind the current target; neither accepts an explicit node. These read-only expressions use their exact source arithmetic with native SpelunkingEfficiency, SpelunkingProwess, and each actual MonsterDefinitionsGET node. No target or game source changes. Efficiency eligibility does not bypass normal map access.
target: Per-node harvest eligibility, harvest chance fraction, and integer pages per drop; no extra-drop or EXP multiplier

extractions.label: cave_node_0_player_3
extractions.expression: (() => { const efficiency = idleon.callFunction("Spelunk", "SpelunkingEfficiency", 0, 0); const prowess = idleon.callFunction("ArbitraryCode", "SpelunkingProwess"); const difficulty = Number(idleon.getAttr("MonsterDefinitionsGET").h.Spelunking0.h.Defence); const ratio = efficiency / difficulty; const harvestChance = ratio >= 0.25 ? Math.min(1.512 * (ratio - 0.0763) / (ratio + 5), 1) : 0; const eligible = harvestChance > 0.05; return { eligible, harvestChance, pagesPerDrop: eligible ? Math.floor(Math.max(Math.pow(efficiency / (10 * difficulty), 0.25 + prowess), 1)) : null, efficiency, prowess, difficulty }; })()
